License the repository under MIT and carry FloatLib's, TorchLean's and Alembic's notices

The repository was public with no licence, while its kernels and contracts reproduce MIT-licensed
FloatLib and TorchLean code whose notices must travel with it. LICENSE puts it under MIT,
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md reproduces the upstream notices and lists what setup downloads, and
REUSE.toml records each file's copyright and licence without touching the files: gate.py, the Lake
files and the contract, verify and bench modules are hashed into the verifier fingerprint, and the
shipped kernels are the champions the boards measure against. The fingerprint is unchanged.
CI runs `reuse lint`, and the miner guide states the licence a submission is made under.

+# Copyright and licence of every file, in the REUSE format (https://reuse.software), so that
+# `reuse lint` can check it. It is kept here rather than in a header in each file because the
+# verifier fingerprint (fingerprint.py) hashes gate.py, the Lake files and the contract, verify and
+# bench modules, and the shipped kernels are the champions boards are measured against: a header
+# would change those bytes. When several annotations match a file, the last one applies.
+# THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md says what each upstream notice covers.
+version = 1
+
+# Everything is this project's, under the MIT licence in LICENSE.
+[[annotations]]
+path = "**"
+SPDX-FileCopyrightText = "2026 Conjectures.io"
+SPDX-License-Identifier = "MIT"
+
+# The contract restates FloatLib's specification, and the kernels and stage 2 reproduce or adapt its
+# certified word kernels and their helpers ("step for step" in `kernels/add/mirror`, and every
+# kernel built from it). FloatLib is MIT-licensed.
+[[annotations]]
+path = ["kernels/**/*.lean", "lean/contract/*.lean", "lean/stage2/**/*.lean"]
+SPDX-FileCopyrightText = ["2026 Conjectures.io", "2026 FloatLib"]
+SPDX-License-Identifier = "MIT"
+
+# The tensor slots also restate TorchLean's `reduceSumLeftSpec` and `bmmSpec` and its obligations
+# (`lean/contract/ContractTensor.lean`, proved equal to TorchLean's in `lean/stage2/Stage2/Link.lean`).
+# TorchLean is MIT-licensed.
+[[annotations]]
+path = [
+    "kernels/sum/**/*.lean",
+    "kernels/bmm/**/*.lean",
+    "kernels/full/**/*.lean",
+    "lean/contract/ContractTensor.lean",
+    "lean/stage2/**/*.lean",
+]
+SPDX-FileCopyrightText = ["2026 Conjectures.io", "2026 FloatLib", "2026 TorchLean"]
+SPDX-License-Identifier = "MIT"
+
+# Alembic's migration template, and the environment script written from Alembic's own. Alembic is
+# MIT-licensed.
+[[annotations]]
+path = ["deploy/migrate/alembic/script.py.mako", "deploy/migrate/alembic/env.py"]
+SPDX-FileCopyrightText = ["2026 Conjectures.io", "2009-2026 Michael Bayer"]
+SPDX-License-Identifier = "MIT"

+for step on bare words, and the faster kernels are built from it.
